Honeypot #2, 2026-11-14 (UTC). "Detected now" means a rule written the same night, after this incident exposed the gap.
Root login over SSH is switched off. 18 guesses
Only checks that the password works
Wazuh rule 40112, level 12: several failures, then
Two new IPs log in on the first try
Rule 100210 raises a High incident. That night it
Pushes its tools in over SCP
Dropper and script copied in through the login
Blocking outbound traffic cannot stop files coming
Delete Google's agent, swap ps, freeze /etc/shadow
The bait account has no root rights. Every one of
Also changes the admin password to lock rivals out
Rule 100212 watches every file in the bait
A 4th IP logs in with that key
Rule 100213 raises a High incident for any key
Rule 100211, written during the attack, caught the
Both files were archived at 02:39, before they
The miner calls its mining pool
10,684 attempts in 13 hours. Not one got out, so
Not reached: root access, outbound connections, other hosts. Isolation was ready if the agent went offline, the victim probed the gateway, or root appeared.
